tests.title: A branch that already exists as refs/heads/<name> resolves as local without any ref write, lock, or fetch
given: a trunk clone with refs/heads/feature-x already present
skip_branch_check is not set
tests.when: the branch-check hook resolves branch_name=feature-x for the workspace
then: resolution is local
no ref is written
wslock.TryLock is never called for this resolution
no network fetch occurs
tests.pseudocode: runner.Run('branch','feature-x'); res := resolveBranch(trunkPath, 'feature-x', mode, false); assert res.path=='local'; assert spyLock.calls==0; assert spyFetch.calls==0

tests.title: A branch present only as refs/remotes/origin/<name> is promoted to a local branch via update-ref, leaving the working tree untouched
given: a trunk clone with refs/remotes/origin/feature-y but no refs/heads/feature-y
the clone's current HEAD is main with a clean working tree
tests.when: the branch-check hook resolves branch_name=feature-y
then: resolution is origin_tracking
refs/heads/feature-y points at the same commit as refs/remotes/origin/feature-y
HEAD is still main and the working tree is unchanged
no checkout or git branch command was run
tests.pseudocode: before := rev_parse('HEAD'); res := resolveBranch(trunkPath, 'feature-y', mode, false); assert res.path=='origin_tracking'; assert rev_parse('refs/heads/feature-y')==rev_parse('refs/remotes/origin/feature-y'); assert rev_parse('HEAD')==before; assert !gitLog.contains('checkout') && !gitLog.contains('branch')

tests.title: In origin mode, a branch absent from both refs/heads and refs/remotes/origin is found via a single-branch fetch and then promoted
given: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE resolves to origin for the workspace
a bare fork repository serving refs/heads/feature-z reachable over the origin remote
the trunk clone has neither refs/heads/feature-z nor refs/remotes/origin/feature-z
tests.when: the branch-check hook resolves branch_name=feature-z
then: exactly one fetch of +refs/heads/feature-z:refs/remotes/origin/feature-z is performed against origin using ResolveCloneAuth's credentials
refs/remotes/origin/feature-z exists afterward
refs/heads/feature-z is created at the fetched commit
resolution is origin_fetch
tests.pseudocode: res := resolveBranch(trunkPath, 'feature-z', 'origin', false); assert fetchSpy.refspecs==['+refs/heads/feature-z:refs/remotes/origin/feature-z']; assert res.path=='origin_fetch'; assert rev_parse('refs/heads/feature-z')==rev_parse('refs/remotes/origin/feature-z')

tests.title: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is re-read on every request rather than cached between registration calls
given: a workspace whose PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is hub
branch_name has neither refs/heads nor refs/remotes/origin locally
tests.when: registration is attempted, PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is then changed to origin, and registration for the same branch_name is attempted again
then: the first attempt does not fetch and fails not-found
the second attempt fetches from origin and can resolve origin_fetch
tests.pseudocode: setVar('PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE','hub'); r1 := post(patches, {branch_name:'w'}); assert r1.status==400; setVar('PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE','origin'); r2 := post(patches, {branch_name:'w'}); assert fetchSpy.calls==1

tests.title: An unset or failing PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE read defaults resolution to hub mode, skipping the fetch
given: the workspace variable store returns an error (or no row) when asked for PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE
branch_name has neither refs/heads nor refs/remotes/origin locally
tests.when: the branch-check hook resolves branch_name
then: no fetch is attempted
resolution fails to find the branch through local and origin_tracking only
the registration request ultimately fails with the not-found outcome, not a variable-read error
tests.pseudocode: store.GetVariableValue = stubError; res, err := resolveBranch(trunkPath, 'w', undefinedMode, false); assert fetchSpy.calls==0; assert err != nil

tests.title: Hub mode never attempts the single-branch fetch even when neither local ref exists
given: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE resolves to hub for the workspace
branch_name has neither refs/heads/<name> nor refs/remotes/origin/<name>
tests.when: the branch-check hook resolves branch_name
then: no network call is made
no refs/remotes/origin/<name> is created
resolution reports not found
tests.pseudocode: res, err := resolveBranch(trunkPath, 'missing', 'hub', false); assert fetchSpy.calls==0; assert err != nil

tests.title: A single registration request fails with 400 and the combined message when none of the three attempts find the branch
given: a carry_patch workspace
branch_name has no refs/heads, no refs/remotes/origin, and (if origin mode) the fetch does not surface it
tests.when: POST /workspaces/:slug/patches is called with that branch_name and skip_branch_check unset
then: the status is 400
the body error is 'branch does not exist in repository or on origin'
no patches row is inserted
tests.pseudocode: r := post(patchesURL, {branch_name:'ghost'}); assert r.status==400; assert r.json.error=='branch does not exist in repository or on origin'; assert patchCount(db,slug)==0

tests.title: A batch registration request fails with 400 naming the failing element's index when its branch cannot be found anywhere
given: a carry_patch workspace
a batch array where element 2's branch_name resolves under none of the three attempts
tests.when: POST /workspaces/:slug/patches is called with the batch array
then: the status is 400
the body error is 'patch[2]: branch does not exist in repository or on origin'
no row from the batch is inserted
tests.pseudocode: r := post(patchesURL, [ok0, ok1, ghost2]); assert r.status==400; assert r.json.error=='patch[2]: branch does not exist in repository or on origin'; assert patchCount(db,slug)==0

tests.title: skip_branch_check true performs none of the resolution reads, writes, or fetches for a single request
given: a spy branch-check hook that records every invocation and every simulated ref/fetch operation
tests.when: POST /workspaces/:slug/patches is called with skip_branch_check=true for a branch_name with no local ref at all
then: the branch-check hook is never invoked
no ref is read or written
no network call is made
validation proceeds to duplicate and position checks
tests.pseudocode: req := {branch_name:'x', skip_branch_check:true}; r := handleAddPatchSingle(req); assert spyHook.calls==0

tests.title: skip_branch_check true always yields the same 'no resolution attempted' outcome regardless of authority mode or request shape
given: a spy branch-check hook
tests.when: for any combination of PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE in {hub, origin} and request shape in {single, batch element}, a request is sent with skip_branch_check=true
then: the spy branch-check hook is never invoked
the inserted patch's audit metadata has no branch_resolution key
the outcome is identical across all combinations
tests.pseudocode: for mode in ['hub','origin']: for shape in ['single','batch']: setVar('PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE', mode); r := send(shape, skip_branch_check=true); assert spyHook.calls==0; assert 'branch_resolution' not in lastAuditEvent.metadata

tests.title: The workspace lock is acquired before the first ref write or fetch of a mutating resolution step
given: a branch_name resolvable only via origin_tracking (needs a local branch created)
a wslock spy recording acquisition order relative to git operations
tests.when: the branch-check hook resolves that branch_name
then: wslock.TryLock is called before update-ref runs
for an origin_fetch case, wslock.TryLock is called before the fetch starts
tests.pseudocode: resolveBranch(trunkPath,'y','hub',false); assert lockSpy.acquiredAt < updateRefSpy.calledAt

tests.title: Registration fails with 409 workspace_busy when the workspace lock is already held, writing no ref and no row
given: a branch_name that requires promoting refs/remotes/origin/<name> to a local branch
the workspace's wslock is already held by a concurrent operation
tests.when: POST /workspaces/:slug/patches is called for that branch_name
then: the status is 409
the error_type is workspace_busy
no ref is written in the trunk clone
no patches row is inserted
tests.pseudocode: unlock,_ := wslock.TryLock(slug); r := post(patchesURL,{branch_name:'y'}); assert r.status==409; assert r.json.error_type=='workspace_busy'; assert patchCount(db,slug)==0; unlock()

tests.title: The workspace lock is released before the patch row is inserted
given: a branch_name resolvable via origin_tracking
tests.when: the full registration request runs to completion
then: the lock is not held while addPatchWithPosition executes
the request still succeeds with 201
tests.pseudocode: r := post(patchesURL,{branch_name:'y'}); assert insertSpy.lockHeldDuringCall==false; assert r.status==201

tests.title: The rev-parse --verify fast path for an already-local branch takes no workspace lock
given: refs/heads/feature-x already exists locally
tests.when: the branch-check hook resolves branch_name=feature-x
then: wslock.TryLock is never called for this resolution
tests.pseudocode: resolveBranch(trunkPath,'feature-x','hub',false); assert lockSpy.calls==0

tests.title: Batch resolution applies to every element under exactly one workspace-lock acquisition before any row is built
given: a batch of three elements, one resolvable as local, one as origin_tracking, one as origin_fetch in origin mode
tests.when: POST /workspaces/:slug/patches is called with the batch array
then: wslock.TryLock is called exactly once for the whole batch's resolution phase
all three elements are resolved before addPatchesBatch is invoked
tests.pseudocode: r := post(patchesURL,[e0,e1,e2]); assert lockSpy.calls==1; assert resolveOrder==['e0','e1','e2']; assert insertSpy.calledAfter(resolveOrder)

tests.title: Batch resolution stops at the first element that cannot be found, resolving no later element
given: a batch of three elements where element 1's branch cannot be found anywhere
tests.when: POST /workspaces/:slug/patches is called with the batch array
then: the 400 response names patch[1]
element 2 is never resolved
no row from the batch is inserted
tests.pseudocode: r := post(patchesURL,[ok0,ghost1,ok2]); assert r.status==400; assert r.json.error=='patch[1]: branch does not exist in repository or on origin'; assert resolveSpy.calledFor.contains('ok2')==false

tests.title: A local branch created for an earlier batch element is left in place after a later element fails the batch
given: a batch of three elements where element 0 resolves origin_tracking (creating refs/heads/e0) and element 2's branch cannot be found
tests.when: POST /workspaces/:slug/patches is called with the batch array and fails at element 2
then: the batch response is 400 naming patch[2]
no patches row is inserted for any element
refs/heads/e0 still exists in the trunk clone
tests.pseudocode: r := post(patchesURL,[e0_tracking,e1_local,ghost2]); assert r.status==400; assert patchCount(db,slug)==0; assert rev_parse('refs/heads/e0') succeeds

tests.title: The workspace lock is released before the batch's atomic insert runs when every element resolves
given: a batch of three elements that all resolve successfully
tests.when: POST /workspaces/:slug/patches is called with the batch array
then: the status is 201 with three created patches
addPatchesBatch runs without the workspace lock held
tests.pseudocode: r := post(patchesURL,[e0,e1,e2]); assert r.status==201; assert insertSpy.lockHeldDuringCall==false

tests.title: handleAddPatchSingle's hub.patch.create event carries branch_resolution alongside branch_name and position
given: a branch_name resolvable via origin_tracking
tests.when: POST /workspaces/:slug/patches is called for that branch_name without skip_branch_check
then: exactly one hub.patch.create event is emitted
its metadata contains branch_name, position, and branch_resolution='origin_tracking'
tests.pseudocode: r := post(patchesURL,{branch_name:'y'}); ev := lastAuditEvent(); assert ev.event_type=='hub.patch.create'; assert ev.metadata.branch_resolution=='origin_tracking'; assert ev.metadata.branch_name=='y'

tests.title: handleAddPatchBatch emits one hub.patch.create event per inserted patch, each with its own branch_resolution
given: a batch of three elements resolving to local, origin_tracking, and origin_fetch respectively (origin mode)
tests.when: POST /workspaces/:slug/patches is called with the batch array and all three rows are inserted
then: exactly three hub.patch.create events are emitted
their branch_resolution values are local, origin_tracking, origin_fetch respectively, matching each element's branch_name and position
tests.pseudocode: r := post(patchesURL,[e0,e1,e2]); events := auditEventsOfType('hub.patch.create'); assert len(events)==3; assert [e.metadata.branch_resolution for e in events]==['local','origin_tracking','origin_fetch']

tests.title: branch_resolution is omitted from hub.patch.create metadata when skip_branch_check bypassed resolution
given: a branch_name with no local ref at all
tests.when: POST /workspaces/:slug/patches is called with skip_branch_check=true for that branch_name
then: the request succeeds
the emitted hub.patch.create event's metadata has no branch_resolution key
tests.pseudocode: r := post(patchesURL,{branch_name:'z', skip_branch_check:true}); ev := lastAuditEvent(); assert 'branch_resolution' not in ev.metadata

tests.title: The recorded branch_resolution always equals the specific path that actually found the branch
given: a workspace where a branch_name can be independently placed at local, origin_tracking, or origin_fetch by test setup
tests.when: for any of the three placements, a patch is registered for that branch_name and inserted
then: the hub.patch.create event's branch_resolution equals the placement used, never one of the other two values
tests.pseudocode: for placement in ['local','origin_tracking','origin_fetch']: setupBranch(placement); r := post(patchesURL,{branch_name:'b_'+placement}); ev := lastAuditEvent(); assert ev.metadata.branch_resolution == placement

tests.title: A genuine secrets-store failure resolving fork credentials for a single registration aborts with 502 and writes no ref or row
given: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE resolves to origin
branch_name has neither refs/heads nor refs/remotes/origin locally
the secrets store returns a genuine error (not 'not configured') when asked for GIT_PAT
tests.when: POST /workspaces/:slug/patches is called for that branch_name
then: the status is 502
the body error is 'credential resolution failed'
no ref is written in the trunk clone
no patches row is inserted
tests.pseudocode: store.GetSecretValue = stubGenuineError; r := post(patchesURL,{branch_name:'w'}); assert r.status==502; assert r.json.error=='credential resolution failed'; assert patchCount(db,slug)==0

tests.title: A genuine credential-resolution failure during batch resolution aborts with 502 naming the failing element's index
given: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE resolves to origin
a batch where element 1's branch requires a fetch and the secrets store fails genuinely for that lookup
tests.when: POST /workspaces/:slug/patches is called with the batch array
then: the status is 502
the body error identifies patch[1] and states credential resolution failed
no row from the batch is inserted
tests.pseudocode: store.GetSecretValue = stubGenuineError; r := post(patchesURL,[ok0, needsFetch1, ok2]); assert r.status==502; assert '1' in r.json.error; assert patchCount(db,slug)==0

tests.title: Absent fork credentials resolve to no auth for the fetch rather than a credential-resolution failure
given: no GIT_PAT and no GIT_USERNAME/GIT_PASSWORD configured for the workspace
PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE resolves to origin
the fork's fetch endpoint accepts unauthenticated requests in the test setup
tests.when: the branch-check hook performs the single-branch fetch step for a branch present on the fork
then: the fetch is attempted with nil auth
resolution succeeds as origin_fetch rather than failing with 502
tests.pseudocode: res, err := resolveBranch(trunkPath,'z','origin',false); assert fetchSpy.auth==nil; assert res.path=='origin_fetch'; assert err==nil

tests.title: A single-branch fetch failure that is not a credential failure folds into the ordinary 400 not-found outcome
given: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE resolves to origin
credentials resolve successfully
the fetch fails because the branch does not exist on the fork
tests.when: POST /workspaces/:slug/patches is called for that branch_name
then: the status is 400, never 502
the body error is 'branch does not exist in repository or on origin'
tests.pseudocode: fetchStub.error = errNoSuchBranchOnRemote; r := post(patchesURL,{branch_name:'ghost'}); assert r.status==400; assert r.json.error=='branch does not exist in repository or on origin'

tests.title: docs/api.md's POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/patches section documents the three-step resolution order and the new 400 message
given: the repository's docs/api.md file
tests.when: the patches add section is read
then: it describes checking a local branch, the origin tracking ref, and (origin mode) a single-branch fetch, in that order
it states the exact 400 message 'branch does not exist in repository or on origin'
tests.pseudocode: content := readFile('docs/api.md'); assert content.contains('tracking'); assert content.contains('branch does not exist in repository or on origin')

tests.title: docs/openapi.yaml's addPatches operation documents the same three-step resolution order and 400 message text as docs/api.md
given: the repository's docs/openapi.yaml file
tests.when: the addPatches operation description is read
then: it describes the same three-step order as docs/api.md
it states the same 400 message text
tests.pseudocode: content := readFile('docs/openapi.yaml'); assert content.contains('branch does not exist in repository or on origin')

tests.title: docs/carry_patch_workflow.md's '3. Add patches' step describes tracking-ref promotion and the origin-mode fetch fallback instead of the retired single-check wording
given: the repository's docs/carry_patch_workflow.md file
tests.when: the '3. Add patches' section is read
then: it no longer states branches are 'validated against the workspace repository at add time'
it describes promotion from the fork's tracking ref and, for origin mode, the single-branch fetch fallback
tests.pseudocode: content := readFile('docs/carry_patch_workflow.md'); assert !content.contains('validated against the workspace repository at add time'); assert content.contains('tracking')

tests.title: afc patch add registers a branch that exists only as the fork's tracking ref, creating a local branch and recording origin_tracking
given: a running hub server with a real carry_patch workspace trunk clone
branch_name was fetched into refs/remotes/origin/<name> by the initial clone but never became a local branch
tests.when: afc patch add is run with that branch_name and no --skip-branch-check
then: the CLI reports HTTP 201 with the created patch
refs/heads/<name> now exists in the trunk clone at the tracking ref's commit
a hub.patch.create audit event was emitted with branch_resolution=origin_tracking

tests.title: A branch pushed to the fork moments ago is resolved and registered via a single-branch fetch in origin mode
given: a running hub server with PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE=origin for the workspace
a real fork remote holding a branch never fetched by the hub before
tests.when: POST /workspaces/:slug/patches is called for that branch_name
then: the response is HTTP 201
refs/remotes/origin/<name> and refs/heads/<name> both now exist in the trunk clone
the hub.patch.create audit event records branch_resolution=origin_fetch
real_components: go-git fetch against a real fork remote

tests.title: Batch registration is all-or-nothing but leaves a harmless local branch behind when a later element fails
given: a running hub server with a real carry_patch workspace trunk clone
a batch of three patch objects where element 2's branch cannot be found anywhere
tests.when: POST /workspaces/:slug/patches is called with the batch, fails, and is then retried with element 2 corrected
then: the first call returns HTTP 400 naming patch[2] and inserts no row
the local branch created for element 1 during the failed attempt is still present
the retried batch returns HTTP 201 with three created patches and three hub.patch.create audit events, each carrying its own branch_resolution

tests.title: A concurrent sync holding the workspace lock defers a registration that would otherwise create a local branch
given: a running hub server
a scheduled sync currently holding the workspace's wslock
a branch_name resolvable via origin_tracking once the lock is free
tests.when: POST /workspaces/:slug/patches is called for that branch_name while sync holds the lock, then retried after sync completes
then: the first call returns HTTP 409 with error_type workspace_busy, writing no ref and inserting no row
the retried call succeeds with HTTP 201 and resolution origin_tracking
